headline: Tiny and mushing out — not worth the gas.
today: Barely knee-high on a short-period S, light dawn wind then onshore by midday. Long-flat closeouts at best. No reason to point the car east today.

daysToWatch.note: Size on paper to 3.7ft but blown out — onshore 14-17mph dawn to afternoon. Only the light evening cleans up, if it holds. Warning, not a target.
This is the drive day — ESE to 3.5ft with offshore N dawn and light morning. Clean and solid, worth the trip if you're going anywhere. Shortboard.
